idea-plugin.name: react-a11y
idea-plugin.description:
Inline WCAG 2.2 accessibility diagnostics and quick fixes for React and React Native, powered by react-a11y.

  • Live diagnostics as you type, with WCAG success criteria and severity on every issue
  • Quick fixes for mechanical problems (misspelled accessibility props, and more)
  • "Fix all" intention for everything auto-fixable in a file
  • Tools → react-a11y: Scan Project runs the project-wide checks (cross-file label resolution, Expo config) and lists results in a console with clickable locations
  • Auto-detects React Native/Expo projects and switches rule packs; respects react-a11y.config.json ignore globs and rule settings

The web rule pack covers what eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y does not (WCAG 2.2 criteria, structure, focus visibility, project-wide checks) — run both for full coverage. Requires Node.js 20+ on your machine. The version-pinned react-a11y CLI ships inside the plugin, and the plugin does not start external processes until the IDE marks the project as trusted.

action.description: Run react-a11y across the project, including project-wide checks live linting cannot do
